what: While the next section rises from the bottom of the screen to reach the top, the inside of the previous section sinks with it by half the screen height (tied to scroll, no curve) at half speed, and the next section covers it — a shopping mall home where sections stack like layered paper

options.rate: Share of the previous section that moves down (screen height × rate), default .5 — 0 means it just passes by
options.next: Selector for the covered section, default next sibling
options.touch: If true, it also applies on phone and tablet devices — the original turns it off when the device (UA) is a phone
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Inner layer to descend into (one direct child, first child if none)

use:
Hero · About…
Features · Products…
Final covering section
note: The covering section needs a background color to cover (if transparent the two sections show overlapping). Not applied to the last section — if the footer is next, the footer covers it

from.where: index.html [data-sink-area] four groups (Hero·About·photo overlap / features·photo band·products·reviews / FAQ / News) — original gsapSectionPin.js ([data-sectionPin-area]·[data-sectionPin-item], y = progress × innerHeight × .5, scrub true, off if isMobile)
